pattern: percentage-point change between two labelled rounds on messy headers, state filter, detail rows only
question: for each district of Bihar how many points did full immunisation of 12-23 month children move between the two rounds
gold_sql: SELECT "District", MAX(CASE WHEN "Survey Round" = 'NFHS-5' THEN "Children age 12-23 months fully vaccinated (%)" END) - MAX(CASE WHEN "Survey Round" = 'NFHS-4' THEN "Children age 12-23 months fully vaccinated (%)" END) AS change_pp FROM district_health_factsheet WHERE "State" = 'Bihar' AND "District" <> 'State Total' GROUP BY "District" ORDER BY "District"
sql_duckdb: WITH base AS (SELECT District, "Children age 12-23 months fully vaccinated (%)" AS pct_nfhs4 FROM district_health_factsheet WHERE State = 'Bihar' AND "Survey Round" = 'NFHS-4'), nfhs5 AS (SELECT District, "Children age 12-23 months fully vaccinated (%)" AS pct_nfhs5 FROM district_health_factsheet WHERE State = 'Bihar' AND "Survey Round" = 'NFHS-5') SELECT b.District, (n.pct_nfhs5 - b.pct_nfhs4) AS points_change FROM base AS b JOIN nfhs5 AS n USING (District)

attempts.response:
WITH base AS (
  SELECT
    District,
    "Children age 12-23 months fully vaccinated (%)" AS pct_nfhs4
  FROM district_health_factsheet
  WHERE State = 'Bihar' AND "Survey Round" = 'NFHS-4'
),
nfhs5 AS (
  SELECT
    District,
    "Children age 12-23 months fully vaccinated (%)" AS pct_nfhs5
  FROM district_health_factsheet
  WHERE State = 'Bihar' AND "Survey Round" = 'NFHS-5'
)
SELECT
  b.District,
  (n.pct_nfhs5 - b.pct_nfhs4) AS points_change
FROM base b
JOIN nfhs5 n USING (District);
